description: This file implements a PHP class for the PDO PostgreSQL (pgsql) driver within the ADOdb database abstraction layer. It defines SQL queries, connection handling, and metadata functions specifically for PostgreSQL databases using PDO.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_pgsql
classes.description: PHP class for PostgreSQL database driver using PDO, providing database-specific SQL and methods for metadata, transactions, and configuration.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves database server version information and description.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with limit and offset support, with optional caching.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Fetches list of tables and views, with optional filtering by name pattern.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for columns of a specified table, including types, defaults, and primary keys.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Begins a database transaction if supported.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Returns a driver-specific placeholder format for bound parameters (:name).
